payload.name: WPVibe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
payload.longDescription: WPVibe 将 ChatGPT 连接至自行托管的 WordPress 网站，让用户通过对话管理内容、检查插件和主题、上传媒体、执行安全的 WordPress 管理命令、使用插件能力，以及构建主题草稿。它包含经过测试的 WordPress 技能和操作指南，涵盖 Gutenberg、Elementor、SeedProd、经典主题、可编辑字段、设计及 SEO 审计；还提供一键授权、经过权限检查的工具，以及草稿—预览—发布工作流，让用户在执行有风险的操作前能够查看和审核变更。

Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.

payload.name: SentinelX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.
payload.longDescription:
SentinelX 让你无需 SSH 即可在 ChatGPT 中管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器。在任意 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装轻量级开源代理，ChatGPT 就能运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件，并调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。

每项操作都受你控制的主机级允许列表约束。代理只会运行你明确声明安全的命令和服务，在代理边界拒绝策略之外的操作，同时仍受操作系统文件权限约束。你可以连接多台主机，并按任意方式为其命名。

常见用途包括：检查运行时间和磁盘空间、重启服务、查看日志末尾、编辑配置文件、运行快捷脚本、管理 DNS 记录和发送通知。该代理在 GitHub 开源（github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core）。身份验证使用 OAuth 2.0（含 PKCE）和动态客户端注册，并按用户授权范围隔离。

payload.name: Context7
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LLMs rely on outdated or generic information about the libraries you use. You get outdated code examples based on year-old training data and hallucinated APIs that don't even exist.

Context7 fetches up-to-date code examples and documentation right into your LLM's context. No tab-switching, no hallucinated APIs that don't exist, no outdated code generation.
payload.longDescription:
LLM 依赖的库信息往往过时或过于笼统。你可能会得到基于一年前训练数据的过时代码示例，以及根本不存在的虚构 API。

Context7 会将最新代码示例和文档直接引入 LLM 的上下文。无需切换标签页，不再遇到虚构 API，也不会生成过时代码。
